templates.name: Bicep Curl Dropset
templates.scientificBasis: Dropsets increase metabolic stress and time under tension, promoting hypertrophy through mechanical and metabolic pathways (Schoenfeld 2010).
templates.notes: Usa manubri per facilitare il cambio peso rapido. Prepara i pesi in anticipo.

templates.name: Leg Press Dropset
templates.scientificBasis: Quad-focused mechanical dropset maximizes muscle fiber recruitment across all rep ranges.
templates.notes: Richiede partner o macchina con piastre facili da rimuovere. Non bloccare le ginocchia.

templates.name: Lateral Raise Dropset
templates.scientificBasis: Isolation movements benefit from dropsets due to limited synergist fatigue (Goto et al. 2004).
templates.notes: Prepara 3 paia di manubri in fila. Zero pausa = massimo pump.

templates.name: Tricep Pushdown Dropset
templates.scientificBasis: Cable machines ideal for dropsets - quick weight changes, constant tension throughout ROM.
templates.notes: Usa perno per cambio peso rapido. Mantieni gomiti fissi.

templates.name: Cable Fly Dropset
templates.scientificBasis: Peak contraction at end range makes flies ideal for metabolic stress via dropsets.
templates.notes: Focus sulla contrazione. Leggero stretch, forte squeeze.

templates.name: Leg Curl Dropset
templates.scientificBasis: Hamstrings respond well to higher volume and metabolic stress techniques.
templates.notes: Non usare momentum. Contrai i glutei per isolare i femorali.
